text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. At its core, NLP focuses on text understanding, allowing machines to grasp not just the words, but also the meaning and context behind them. This technology powers everyday tools like machine translation, which can instantly convert a sentence from English to Japanese, or sentiment analysis, which tells companies whether online reviews are positive or negative. Perhaps the most visible application is chatbots, which now handle customer service questions, book appointments, and even give friendly advice. While NLP is not perfect, it has made huge progress, and it continues to break down barriers between people and machines.
